addons.name: Gateway Credits
addons.description: A shared prepaid credit balance for provider-calling nodes: an agent with model / memory / tool sub-nodes, metering (hold / settle / refund) per step, routing policy, budgets, an admin ledger and app-like node faces. Simulated providers.

addons.name: Client Hubs
addons.description: A client deliverable hub on the 3D canvas: blueprint → pages → tasks. The real hub pages (website, customer app, staff desks, manual, docs, dev tools) are embedded live as nodes and the canvas re-arranges into delivery, audience, site-map, compare and device flows.
